selection.rule: lowest 25% quantile of cnr = (p99(V) - v_bg) / (1.4826*MAD_bg); cut = 28.5518
selection.computed_from: pixels only: V = median(R,G,B), background level and MAD from features.estimate_bg on the top/bottom margin rows, plus percentile(V, 99). No band, no edge detection, no coverage, no diameter enters the score.

width_invariance_across_k.definition: per image, (max over k of median width) - (min over k of median width)
